episode.title: A Tale As Old As Showers | Brainstorm Brewery #703 | Magic Finance
episode.description: Liz (@devotedDruid) is back with Corbin (@CHosler) and DJ (@CardgardenMTG) to tell you the easiest possible way to get better at magic and clean up RCQs, and how collectibles could merge with 5-way parleys. Check us out on YouTube because everything is better with video. https://www.youtube.com/BrainstormBrewery
